textualReviewScope.quizScope: Actual labels, three curated wrong choices, five direct kanji/seven direct word guards, ordinary secondary senses, excessive/missing-pair risks and legacy fallbacks. Actual qualified builder/live-pool/native checks remain later gates.
textualReviewScope.readingScope: Sole full/selected ガイ yields がい, no kunyomi; exact allocation in 弾劾 and distinct 弾 component sense.
textualReviewScope.meaningScope: Impeachment versus wider denunciation, transitive suru/object roles, noun construction, no guilt/fairness/completed-removal inference and no inferred vocabulary level.
textualReviewScope.fontScope: Actual28Han, 刂 absent from all three bundled cmaps; later native four-mode rendering required.
textualReviewScope.process: TWO actual different model families, independent blind initials on identical frozen teaching; ONE active reviewer and serial internal tools; no author rationale/other report in initial prompts.

limits: Byte freeze, not reviewer comprehension, linguistic correctness, app/native/font/phone acceptance or publication.
